mapper.sql: select a.appointment_id, a.appointment_name, a.owner, a.owner_id, a.location, a.is_virtual, a.is_allday, a.repeat_type, a.end_repeat, a.duration, a.reminder, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.relate_id, a.relate_name, a.relate_type, a.appointment_status, a.agenda, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.user_id, a.dept_id, a.notes, a.conclusion from crm_appointment a left join sys_user u on u.user_id = a.user_id left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id
mapper.select: select a.appointment_id, a.appointment_name, a.owner, a.owner_id, a.location, a.is_virtual, a.is_allday, a.repeat_type, a.end_repeat, a.duration, a.reminder, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.relate_id, a.relate_name, a.relate_type, a.appointment_status, a.agenda, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.user_id, a.dept_id, a.notes, b.attendee_id as sub_attendee_id, b.appointment_id as sub_appointment_id, b.attendee_name as sub_attendee_name, b.attendee_type as sub_attendee_type, b.attendee_refid as sub_attendee_refid, b.create_by as sub_create_by, b.create_time as sub_create_time, b.update_by as sub_update_by, b.update_time as sub_update_time, b.org_id as sub_org_id, b.full_name as sub_full_name from crm_appointment a left join crm_attendee b on b.appointment_id = a.appointment_id where a.appointment_id = #{appointmentId}

mapper.select: select c.contact_id, c.org_id, c.account_id, c.name, c.full_name, c.account_name, c.salutation, c.title, c.marital_status, c.birthDate, c.age, c.work_phone, c.work_email, c.gender, c.personal_email, c.mobile_phone, c.client_type, c.territory, c.owner, c.management_level, c.department, c.reports_to, c.reports_to_id, c.favorability_rating, c.influence_rating, c.assistant, c.assistant_phone, c.assistant_email, c.allow_call, c.allow_email, c.is_customer, c.is_org_customer, c.responsibility, c.active_opty_count, c.active_lead_count, c.active_opty_amount, c.status, c.working_years, c.is_active, c.degree, c.major, c.origin, c.original_source, c.sid, c.source_lead_id, c.first_visit_clinic_id, c.imaging_portal_url, c.imaging_patient_external_id, c.first_visit_at, c.last_visit_at, c.visit_count, c.acquisition_cost, c.wecom_external_userid, c.wecom_follow_userid, c.wecom_name, c.wecom_avatar, c.wecom_gender, c.wecom_type, c.wechat, c.location, c.school, c.tag, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.user_id, c.dept_id, c.custom_field, c.sid, c.resources, c.requirement, c.rr_description, c.name_card, c.avatar, c.priority from crm_contact c left join sys_user u on u.user_id = c.user_id left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id where NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM crm_appointment a WHERE a.relate_id = c.contact_id AND a.appointment_status = 'completed' AND a.start_time >= CURRENT_DATE - #{daysThreshold} * INTERVAL '1 day' )

SELECT appointment_id, appointment_name, owner, owner_id, location, is_virtual, is_allday, repeat_type, end_repeat, duration, reminder, start_time, end_time, relate_id, relate_name, relate_type, appointment_status, agenda, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, user_id, dept_id, notes, conclusion FROM crm_appointment WHERE start_time >= #{windowStart} AND start_time < #{windowEnd} AND relate_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(relate_id) <> '' AND (appointment_status IS NULL OR LOWER(appointment_status) NOT IN ('cancelled', 'canceled', 'completed')) ORDER BY start_time ASC LIMIT 200
